item.title: Aquarius rising: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Aquarius rising means Aquarius was the sign on the eastern horizon at the moment and place you were born. In astrology the rising sign stands for the first impression you give; Aquarius is an air sign ruled by Saturn, with Uranus as its modern ruler, fresh and independent. You arrive slightly outside the circle, seeing it whole. Read more at astralroots.app
